commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/growbox_shelly_rf_power_calibration_v2.json')
if not p.exists():
    raise SystemExit('missing calibration file')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
print(f"settle_seconds={d['settle_seconds']:.0f}")
print(f"baseline_w={d['baseline']['power_median_w']:.3f}")
for name in ('lamp','fan','humidifier'):
    x=d[name]
    print(f"{name} pre_w={x['pre']['power_median_w']:.3f} on_w={x['on']['power_median_w']:.3f} off_w={x['off']['power_median_w']:.3f} delta_on_w={x['delta_on_w']:.3f} delta_off_w={x['delta_off_w']:.3f} agreement_w={x['delta_agreement_w']:.3f} voltage_v={x['on']['voltage_median_v']:.2f}")
print(f"final_w={d['final']['power_median_w']:.3f}")
PY
